 Advertisement Updated: 9:02 AM EDT Oct 21, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Danielle Scruggs Find your early voting location for Florida's 2026 general election
 Updated: 9:02 AM EDT Oct 21, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Danielle Scruggs From Palm Beach to Okeechobee, here's where you can vote early for Florida's 2026 general election.
 WPBF 25 Interactive Voter Guide for 2026 Florida general election Election Day is Tuesday, Nov. 3.
 Advertisement Palm Beach County
 Early voting is Monday, Oct. 19, through Sunday, Nov. 1, from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
 Early voting locations are as follows:
 Belle Glade — Belle Glade Library/Civic Center — 725 NW Fourth St.
 Boca Raton — Boca Raton Downtown Library — 400 NW Second Ave.
 Boca Raton — Glades Road Branch Library — 20701 95th Avenue South
 Boca Raton — Spanish River Library — 1501 Spanish River Blvd.
 Boca Raton — Sugar Sand Park Community Center — 300 S Military Trail
 Boca Raton — West Boca Raton Branch Library — 18685 State Road 7
 Boynton Beach — Canyon Branch Library — 8915 Sen. Joe Abruzzo Ave.
 Boynton Beach — Ezell Hester Community Center — 1901 N. Seacreat Blvd.
 Delray Beach — Delray Beach Community Center — 50 NW First Ave.
 Delray Beach — Dr. Andre Fladell Civic Center — 16700 Jog Road
 Delray Beach — Hagen Ranch Road Library — 14350 Hagen Ranch Road
 Greenacres — Greenacres Community Center — 501 Swain Blvd.
 Jupiter — FAU Jupiter Campus — 5353 Parkside Drive
 Jupiter — Jupiter Community Center — 200 Military Trail
 Lake Worth — Lantana Road Branch Library — 4020 Lantana Road
 Lake Worth — Palm Beach State College Main Campus — 4200 S. Congress Ave.
 Loxahatchee — Acreage Branch Library — 15801 Orange Blvd.
 Loxahatchee Groves — Palm Beach State College Loxahatchee Groves Campus — 15845 Southern Blvd.
 Pahokee — Loula V. York Branch Library — 525 Bacon Point Road
 Palm Beach Gardens — Gardens Branch Library — 11202 Campus Drive
 Riviera Beach — Wells Rec Community Center — 2409 Avenue H West
 Royal Palm Beach — Royal Palm Beach Branch Library — 500 Civic Center Way
 Tequesta — Tequesta Recreation Center — 399 Seabrook Road
 Wellington — Wellington Branch Library — 1951 Royal Fern Drive
 West Palm Beach — Gaines Park Community Center — 1501 N. Australian Ave.
 West Palm Beach — Howard Park Community Center — 1302 Parker Ave.
 West Palm Beach — Main Library — 3650 Summit Blvd.
 West Palm Beach — Supervisor of Elections — 4301 Cherry Road
 West Palm Beach — South Florida Fairgrounds — 9067 Southern Blvd.
 In Politics: WPBF 25 to produce, moderate, and televise Florida's 2026 US Senate and gubernatorial debates 
 On Election Day, you must vote at your assigned polling place. To find yours, click here .
 The deadline to request a mail-in ballot is Thursday, Oct. 22, at 5 p.m.
 Secure vote-by-mail ballot boxes will also be available at the main office on Election Day. All ballots must be received by 7 p.m. on Election Day to count.
 Ballots can be tracked by clicking here .
 For more information, click here .

 Early voting is from Wednesday, Oct. 21, until Saturday, Oct. 31, from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. at all six early voting locations.
 Elections Center — 135 SE Martin Luther King, Jr. Blvd., Stuart
 Elisabeth Lahti Library — 15200 E Thelma Waters Ave., Indiantown
 Hobe Sound Library — 10595 SE Federal Highway, Hobe Sound
 Hoke Library — 1150 Jack Williams Way, Jensen Beach
 Peter & Julie Cummings Library — 2551 SW Matheson Ave., Palm City
 Robert Morgade Library — 5851 SE Community Dr., Stuart
 The deadline to request a mail-in ballot is Oct. 22 at 5 p.m.
 2026 Midterm Elections: Early voting tracking map by state, party Stay up-to-date: The latest headlines and weather from WPBF 25 
 St. Lucie County
 Early voting is Monday, Oct. 19 through Saturday, Oct. 31, from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m. daily, including Sunday, Oct. 25.
 Early voting locations as follows:
 Fort Pierce — Renaissance Business Park (Formerly Orange Blossom Business Center) — 4132 Okeechobee Road
 Fort Pierce — Zora Neale Hurston Library — 3008 Avenue D
 Port St. Lucie — Indian River State College Veterans Center of Excellence — 500 NW California Blvd.
 Port St. Lucie — MIDFLORIDA Credit Union Event Center — 9221 S.E. Event Center Place
 Port St. Lucie — Paula A. Lewis Library — 2950 SW Rosser Blvd.
 Port St. Lucie — Port St. Lucie Community Center — 2195 SE Airoso Blvd.
 Port St. Lucie — Robert E. Minsky Gym: New Location — 750 S.W. Darwin Blvd.
 Fort Pierce — Lakewood Park Branch Library — 7605 Santa Barbara Drive
 The deadline to request a mail-in ballot is Oct. 22 at 5 p.m.
 Port St. Lucie mayoral candidates discuss growth and investment in debate Around the country: National coverage from WPBF 25 News 
 Indian River County
 Early voting is Monday, Oct. 19, through Saturday, Oct. 31, from 8 a.m. until 4 p.m. Extended hours are Thursdays from 8 a.m. until 6 p.m.
 Early voting locations are as follows:
 Sebastian — Sebastian City Hall Council Chambers — 1225 Main St.
 Vero Beach — Indian River County Main Library — 1600 21st St.
 Vero Beach — Indian River County Supervisor of Elections Office — 4375 43rd Ave.
 Vero Beach — Intergeneration Recreation Center (Room 112) — 1590 9th St. SW
 The deadline to request a mail-in ballot is Oct. 22 at 5 p.m.
 Follow us on social: Facebook | X | Instagram | YouTube | TikTok 
 Okeechobee County
 Early voting is from Saturday, Oct. 24, through Saturday, Oct. 31, from 8:30 a.m. until 6 p.m.
 Early voting locations are as follows:
 Okeechobee — Historic Courthouse — 307 NW 5th Ave.
 The deadline to request a mail-in ballot is Oct. 22 at 5 p.m.
 The deadline to register to vote was Monday, Oct. 5.
